ValueSet-anc-b7-de73.title: Presenting signs and symptoms that trigger suspicion of IPV and clinical inquiry Choices Schema
ValueSet-anc-b7-de73.description: JSON Schema for Presenting signs and symptoms that trigger suspicion of IPV and clinical inquiry Choices ValueSet codes. Values are represented as Coding objects with 'system' and 'code' properties.
ValueSet-anc-b7-de73.narrative: This schema validates Coding-shaped objects for the Presenting signs and symptoms that trigger suspicion of IPV and clinical inquiry Choices ValueSet. Each value must be an object with 'system' (CodeSystem URI) and 'code' (fragment after '#') properties. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/anc/ValueSet-anc-b7-de73.displays.json. The canonical IRI for a code can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
